findings.claim: The `try: from datetime import UTC … except ImportError` fallback for Python < 3.11 guards an interpreter the rest of the engine rules out: the two callers of board.py (gate.py, lesson_queue.py) and its two companions on the same runner (board_review.py, board_state.py) import `UTC` unconditionally, so `from datetime import UTC, datetime` alone keeps behaviour identical.

`from datetime import UTC, datetime` unconditional; lesson_queue.py:50 says 'Python 3.11+'; lesson_queue.py:383 is the caller of `board.rule_question`
